## Headroom Learned Patterns
  *Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-10-18 — do not edit manually*
  
  ### Truncated Output Prevention
  *~9,000 tokens/session saved*
  - NEVER re-run `scripts/native/android_build.sh` or pytest expecting full terminal output. Instead: `scripts/native/android_build.sh > /tmp/rt-build.log 2>&1; grep -E 'error|FAIL|Error' /tmp/rt-build.log | head -50`
  - For cmake builds, always pipe: `cmake --build build/X --target Y -j4 2>&1 | tee /tmp/rt-ck.log | grep -E 'error|FAILED' | head -30`. Re-read the log file rather than rebuilding.
  - For pytest: `python3 -m pytest tests/native_parity -q > /tmp/rt-test.log 2>&1; tail -80 /tmp/rt-test.log`. Do not re-run the test command 9× to see different output.
  
  ### Build & Test Commands
  *~6,902 tokens/session saved*
  - CMake for native tests: `cmake -S src/native -B build/w-W{wave}-{num} -DRT_NATIVE_ASSETS_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release` then `cmake --build build/w-W{wave}-{num} --target w{wave}_{name}_test rt-app -j4`
  - Run test binary: `./build/w-W3-05/w3_script_bridge_test` (binary lives directly in build dir)
  - ROM-dependent tests need: `RT_ELF="$HOME/Library/Application Support/RoadTripRecomp/disc/SLUS_203.98"`
  - To skip Android/VRC checks during configure: prefix with `RT_SKIP_ANDROID_CHECK=1 RT_SKIP_VRC_PLUGIN=1`
  
  ### File Paths & Structure
  *~6,902 tokens/session saved*

  ### macOS/BSD Shell Quirks
  *~6,902 tokens/session saved*
  - `sed -i` requires empty string arg on macOS: use `sed -i '' 's/foo/bar/' file` (NOT `sed -i 's/foo/bar/'`).
  - `grep` with paths that don't exist will fail the whole command — verify paths exist first or use `grep -r ... 2>/dev/null`.
  - The ROM file is at `build/rom/SLUS_203.98` relative to project root; scratch scripts in `build/scratch/` must use absolute paths.
